title: OpenPIA validation rules (A55)
description: Declarative definitions of what makes an A55 submission complete and compliant. These describe the rules; they do not prescribe an engine, a score, or any machine learning. Whether a photo shows the right thing — content assessment — is out of scope. Derived from a canonical A55 rule set; to be ratified with practitioners.

families.structural: Submission and point shape — required structure and recognised values.
families.evidence: Evidence slot presence and file integrity.
families.cross_field: Consistency between declared values and physical logic.
families.image_quality: Deterministic image gates — blur, exposure, and resolution.

mandatory_note: A mandatory rule is always applied. A non-mandatory rule may be switched off per adopter; a disabled rule produces no defect and drops out of any completeness measure, so results stay comparable.

rules.description: submission_type is a recognised notice type (a55a or a55b).
submission_uid is present and a valid UUID — the record's own identity, referenced by A55b stages through parent_submission_uid.
Path works carry both a start point and an end point; point-type works are exempt.
Blockage and pole-bend works carry one or two blockage points.
At least one work point is present.
Each point's latitude and longitude fall within United Kingdom bounds.
A point's latitude/longitude agrees with its easting/northing to within roughly fifty metres.
traffic_management is a recognised value.
infrastructure_type is recognised and maps to a category.
point_index values run sequentially from zero.
A route-bearing submission declares a surface type.
A chamber-category point without duct data is flagged.
A pole point without a distribution-point number is flagged.
A point carrying latitude/longitude but no British National Grid easting/northing is noted.
pia_noi_reference is present.
parent_submission_uid is present — every A55b civil-evidence report belongs to a parent A55a, and this is the link between them.
parent_submission_uid resolves to a known A55a submission_uid; applied when the parent A55a set is available to the validator.
The close-off stage is present across the A55b reports sharing a parent_submission_uid; only close-off is required.
A repair-and-installation stage carries excavation dimensions.
A reinstatement stage carries reinstatement dimensions.
Every required evidence slot, and every conditional slot whose condition holds, has at least one file. The slot catalogue in evidence/slots.json is the source of which slots apply.

enforcement.requirement: Every slot whose requirement is `required`, and every slot whose requirement is `conditional` and whose `when` condition holds for the submission, has at least one evidence file.

rules.description: An evidence item is captured within roughly two hundred metres of the point it belongs to.
Each evidence item carries a capture timestamp.
An evidence item's capture timestamp is within thirty days of submission.
No two evidence files in a submission share the same file_hash, which would mean one image reused across slots.

Each evidence item's recorded hash-verification outcome is consistent: where the declared file_hash was checked against the fetched file, the two matched. An item with no file_hash, or one whose file was never fetched, is not verified rather than failed — the byte comparison runs in the fetch pipeline, and this rule reads its recorded result.
Each evidence file is retrievable from its file_url.
A traffic-management board photograph is present whenever traffic management is active.
An evidence file matches its declared evidence_type.
Evidence slot codes belong to the A55a taxonomy for the works type.
A declared route length agrees with the summed point-to-point GPS distance to within roughly twenty per cent.
A declared blockage span agrees with the distance between the blockage points.
A pole-bend job starts at a chamber-category point and ends at a pole.
High capacity utilisation calls for additional evidence.
A road or lane closure carries the relevant site-detail fields.
Completed works declared not to match the original plan are flagged.
A close-off stage declaring the job not complete is flagged.
An image is not blurred beyond a deterministic sharpness threshold.
An image is neither significantly under- nor over-exposed, by deterministic thresholds.
An image meets a minimum resolution.
